name: Fluted Glass Background
description: An animated WebGL background for React: a soft, drifting mesh gradient seen through ribbed, fluted glass, with curved shading, edge highlights and a light that follows the cursor. Raw WebGL2, no dependencies; pauses off screen.

props.name: colors
props.description: Up to four colours for the gradient behind the glass. Each drifts on its own slow orbit; fewer than four repeat.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Colour of the light that follows the pointer.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How strongly each flute bends what's behind it. 0 gives flat panes.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the light that follows the pointer. 0 turns it off.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the gradient drifts. 0 holds it still.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How far the light trails the pointer, from 0 (glued) to 0.98 (slow).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
